links.outcome: Gastroenterologist-rated accuracy of ChatGPT responses on Barrett's esophagus questions
links.effect: Mean accuracy 4.01 out of 5; 79.3% of responses completely accurate or mostly accurate with minor errors, implying about one fifth had greater inaccuracies.
links.quote: Gastroenterologists rated ChatGPT responses as mostly accurate overall (4.01 out of 5) with 79.3% of responses completely accurate or mostly accurate with minor errors.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT 4.0 outputs for Barrett's esophagus questions assessed by gastroenterologists and patients, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
